note: Soldier, front view, spear held upright in the left (image-left) gauntleted fist. Head is the green helmet, the hair, beard and ear, bottom y~452 at the beard tip (the hair on the right hangs to y~468); the green collar, jacket, belt, pouches, the purple cape between the legs and at the right hip, and the brown strap or scabbard hanging at the right hip (x716-790, y636-800) are torso. Left arm is bent like the soldier's other sprite: green sleeve and bare skin are the upper arm (x355-403, y468-605) to the elbow y~600, the brown bracer, green strip and grey cuff are the forearm (x312-386, y515-610) running left to the wrist x~315, and the gauntlet fist with peach fingers round the shaft is the hand (x240-315, y512-612). The spear is equipment: the leaf-shaped head (tip at (218,100)) with its socket, and the brown shaft above the fist (y356-526) and below it down to y~900, kept off the fist. Right arm hangs: green sleeve and bare skin are the upper arm to y~558 (material change to the brown bracer), the bracer and green cuff are forearm to the wrist y~637, the grey gauntlet fist with fingertips is the hand (y636-708). The trousers are tucked into the boots with no bare skin: hip at the crotch y~725, thigh is the baggy trouser leg to the boot cuff top (left y790, right y795), which is above halfway so it is the knee; boots are lower leg to the ankles (y~855), toes are feet.
